title: Three-Question Intent Clinic + Blocker Triage
content:
Context: quick weekly ritual for keeping personal outcomes aligned with work priorities. Designed to be done in 15-20 minutes on Monday morning or Friday afternoon. Combines a 3-question retro with an "intent map" and a short blocker clinic so I can start the week with clear micro-actions.

Three-question retro (3 min):
- Win: What moved the needle last week? (one short sentence)
  - Example: 'Reduced model inference tail latency by ~70ms via config tweak, unblocks Dedicated benchmark.'
- Blocker: What stopped progress or took unexpected time? (one short sentence)
  - Example: 'Dependency mismatches on new quantized runtime; delayed rollout.'
- Hypothesis / Next bet: If I remove the blocker or double-down on the win, what will I expect next week? (one short sentence)
  - Example: 'If I get the quantized runtime dependency pinned, we can run the full 8-hour soak and measure cost savings.'

Intent map (8–10 min): top 3 intentional outcomes for the week, each with 2 micro-actions and one leading indicator. Keep measurable and timeboxed.

1) Outcome: Close the Dedicated perf regression (customer A)
   - Micro-actions:
     - Run perf profile on dedicated model queue (2h, Mon AM)
     - Push config rollback for canary and monitor 30m after deploy
   - Leading indicator: Canary P50 latency drops below 160ms within 30m of deploy
   - Metric to report: delta P50 and p95 vs baseline (send short note to #dedicated-status)

2) Outcome: Reduce personal context-switching to preserve 8h focus blocks
   - Micro-actions:
     - Batch non-urgent Slack messages into two scheduled windows (10:00, 15:30)
     - Turn off notifications and use 90-min deep-work timer twice per day
   - Leading indicator: uninterrupted deep-work blocks >= 2 
   - Metric to track: total uninterrupted focus minutes / day (approx via calendar)

3) Outcome: Ship the 'intent-map' doc for team adoption
   - Micro-actions:
     - Draft first pass and ask Rhea for feedback (Mon afternoon)
     - Publish short how-to + 1 example into team drive (Wed)
   - Leading indicator: Rhea provides feedback within 24h of ping
   - Metric: doc published + 1 team attempt next week

Blocker clinic (3–5 min): triage current blockers and the single next step to clear them. Prioritize one 'lobotomy' move (a quick surgical action that either clears or fails fast).

- Blocker A: quantized runtime dependency incompatibility
  - Single next step: create minimal repro in a new branch and open a devcontainer so infra can reproduce (2h)
  - Risk if not cleared: dedicated perf tests delayed, rollout window missed

- Blocker B: overloaded on ad-hoc meetings
  - Single next step: mark two recurring slots as 'no-meeting deep work' and inform manager by EOD

Mini experiments (hypotheses, 1-week horizon):
- Experiment 1: Scheduled Slack batching will increase uninterrupted focus minutes by 20%
  - Success criteria: average focus minutes/day up by >=20% by week end
- Experiment 2: Publishing one worked example of the intent-map will lead to 1 team adoption next sprint
  - Success criteria: at least one teammate copies doc and runs it with their own OKRs

Weekly metrics snapshot (quick signals, not exhaustive):
- Signal 1 (progress): Closed PRs that advanced the Dedicated perf work: 3 changes landed
- Signal 2 (health): Personal focus blocks achieved: 2 / 2 target
- Signal 3 (quality): Canary errors during rollout: 0
- Signal 4 (momentum): Shared doc authorship pinged: Rhea (1), Noah (1)

Reflection prompts (end of week):
- What did I under/overestimate?
- Which micro-action produced the most leverage?
- What should I stop doing next week?

Gratitude & small wins (one line):
- "Grateful that bench tests reproduced quickly, saved time"

Quick TODO list (atomic items):
- [ ] Create perf repro branch (2h)
- [ ] Schedule 'no-meeting' calendar blocks and inform manager
- [ ] Draft intent-map doc and ask Rhea for feedback
- [ ] Batch Slack windows and post schedule in #random
- [ ] Run canary rollback test and capture metrics

Notes & links:
- Attach perf traces to JIRA-ENG-4389 after repro completed
- See previous week notes: slack thread msg-5478 for context

How to use this doc:
- Open first on Monday, answer 3 quick questions, then update the intent map. Keep it intentionally short — this is a operational artifact, not a narrative. Tweak experiment list as needed and mark successes/failures in the next week's quick retro.

Version: v0.3 (working).
